# DiskLens — SpaceCorps Agent Manual

> DiskLens is a native Rust desktop file explorer and disk space analyzer that provides real-time percentage gauges of volume capacity and folder weight.

## Core Capabilities

- **Launch:** `disklens [PATH]`
- **Help:** `disklens --help`
- **Version:** `disklens --version`
- **Percentage Modes:**
  - `DiskPercent`: `(size_bytes / volume.total_bytes) * 100.0`
  - `FolderPercent`: `(size_bytes / current_folder_total_size) * 100.0`
  - `Dual`: Both metrics displayed concurrently
- **Presets:**
  - `All`: Unfiltered entries
  - `FoldersOnly`: Subdirectories only
  - `HeavyOnly`: Entries >= 100 MB
  - `MassiveOnly`: Entries >= 1 GB
  - `DevArtifacts`: `.git`, `node_modules`, `target`, `dist`, `build`, `.cache`

## Severity Thresholds

- Crimson (`#EF4444`): Disk % >= 5.0% or Folder % >= 40.0%
- Amber (`#F59E0B`): Disk % >= 1.0% or Folder % >= 15.0%
- Blue (`#38BDF8`): Disk % >= 0.2% or Folder % >= 5.0%
- Emerald (`#10B981`): Disk % < 0.2% or Folder % < 5.0%
